trial_title: Evaluation of a Novel Technique to Diagnose Carotid Artery Stenosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the accuracy of a new non-invasive device, the Carotid Stenotic Scan (CSS), to check for stenosis of the internal carotid artery (ICA) as compared to a carotid ultrasound study.

eligibility_table.criterion: Outpatients age > 18 years sent to the vascular laboratory for carotid duplex examination for initial carotid ultrasound study or for follow-up of known carotid disease.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is a male over 18 years old and has undergone a carotid ultrasound study, meeting the outpatient requirement.

eligibility_table.criterion: Enrolled patients will include at least 100 subjects with at least moderate known stenosis (50-69% or greater, PSV > 125 cm/sec) or occlusion of one or both ICAs
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's carotid stenosis status is not explicitly provided; thus, it is unclear if he meets the criteria for moderate stenosis or occlusion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a carotid artery stenosis of 50-69% or greater, as indicated by a peak systolic velocity (PSV) greater than 125 cm/sec?

eligibility_table.criterion: Up to 25 patients with known fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD) of the internal carotid arteries.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD) of the internal carotid arteries, as his conditions do not indicate this diagnosis.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently aged less than 18 years?
Has the patient been hospitalized for at least 24 hours due to complications related to carotid artery stenosis?
Is the patient currently able to understand the nature of the study and provide informed consent as assessed by a standardized cognitive evaluation tool?

eligibility_table.criterion: Prior history of carotid endarterectomy or carotid artery stent.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a carotid endarterectomy or received a carotid artery stent prior to this evaluation?
Has the patient undergone any neck surgery prior to the evaluation for carotid artery stenosis?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known prosthetic heart valve, known critical aortic stenosis, or study indication 'preop' open heart or aortic surgery.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a known prosthetic heart valve or a known critical aortic stenosis with a valve area <1 cm²?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Inability to provide informed consent.
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Prior history of carotid endarterectomy or carotid artery stent.
